Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management Holds Stake in Apple (AAPL); Belmond LTD (BEL) Holder Starwood Capital Group Management Has Decreased Its Stake
May 18, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3114.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management bought 31,147 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 32,147 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.44 million, up from 1,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $919.08B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.63% or $1.19 during the last trading session, reaching $186.99. About 15.62M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Starwood Capital Group Management Llc decreased its stake in Belmond Ltd. (BEL) by 7.26% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Starwood Capital Group Management Llc sold 324,998 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.76% with the market. The institutional investor held 4.15 million shares of the hotels and resorts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $50.84M, down from 4.48 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Starwood Capital Group Management Llc who had been investing in Belmond Ltd. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.20B market cap company. (NYSE:BEL) has declined 6.22% since May 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.77% the S&P500.
